overview.description: The Volatility Shares Trust XRP ETF (XRPI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund is an actively managed fund, offering price participation in XRP using near-term futures and XRP-linked instruments. The fund does not directly invest in XRP XRPI was launched on May 22, 2025 and is issued by Volatility Shares.
